name: fxapis
description: Your MetaTrader 5 accounts in Claude Code through fxapis: accounts, positions, prices and trading over MCP; a safe-trading skill; and a hook that has you confirm every trade and refuses live accounts unless you allow them.

api_key.title: fxapis API key (optional)
api_key.description: Leave empty to sign in to fxapis in your browser on first use. Set an fx_live_… key only for agents that run unattended.

allowLiveTrading.title: Allow trades on live accounts
allowLiveTrading.description: Off: trades on accounts fxapis reports as live are refused. Demo accounts trade, each after you confirm it.
